name: Duffield's Farm Market
description: Duffield's Farm Market is a small farm in Sewell, NJ. It grows Strawberries, Apples, Pumpkins, Corn, and Peas, with seasonal availability through spring and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
